transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

I’ve just been feeling really down and depressed, and I've completely lost interest in all the things I used to enjoy. This has been going on for about a year and two months now, and I just don't have the motivation to do anything.
Have you had a period of at least 2 months during this time when you felt back to your usual self, or has it been present most days for the whole 1 year and 2 months?
No, I haven't had any breaks or felt like my old self at all. It has been like this pretty much every single day for the entire year and two months. It just doesn't seem to let up.
